statement: Independent community and wireless-receiver implementation document the 045e:0719 USB receiver as its own multi-slot proprietary 2.4 GHz protocol gateway, not a wired 045e:028e controller or ordinary Bluetooth controller; per-slot status/disconnect and prefixed controller reports differ.
